register: # PROTOCOL: jk_bms_modbus_rtu - JK BMS RS485 Modbus RTU (JK 'RS485 Modbus Universal Protocol V1.1'). Choose this when the BMS UART port is set to protocol 001 (115200 baud) or 013 (9600 baud).

# NOT THIS PROTOCOL: UART protocol 000 ('4G-GPS' / GPS Remote Module Common Protocol, the 4E 57 binary protocol) is jk_bms_4g_gps_serial, which uses the serial_jk transport. Bluetooth (BLE) is a third, separate JK interface and is not supported.

# SOURCE: JK RS485 Modbus Universal Protocol V1.1 register table as reproduced in phinix-org/Multiple-JK-BMS-by-Modbus-RS485; JK-PB addresses cross-checked against syssi/esphome-jk-bms (esp8266-jk-pb-modbus-example.yaml). Not tested against hardware by the author of this map.

# ADDRESSING: JK offsets are BYTE offsets (16-bit values step by 2, 32-bit values by 4). The protocol JSON sets register_address_step = 2 so MPG knows word i of a block read starting at address a belongs to address a + 2*i. Every register in this file is the JK address in decimal (the note shows it in hex). batch_size is in address units (128 addresses = up to 64 words per read).

# WORD ORDER: 32-bit values are standard big-endian (high word first), the app default, as in ESPHome's U_DWORD. Packed byte pairs: the first field listed by JK is the HIGH byte (.b8), the second is the LOW byte (.b0).

# READ ONLY: every row is read-only on purpose. JK supports Modbus function codes 03 and 16 only, and several settings share one register as two bytes. The 0x1600 control block (calibration, shutdown, chemistry presets, bulk-frame download) is not mapped.

# NOT COVERED: per-cell connection-line resistance settings (0x1088-0x1104), alarm/temperature-sensor presence byte (0x12D0), battery voltage correction float (0x12DC), data-field-enable, dry-node and buzzer settings (0x14E4+), Bluetooth name, PIN, password and user-data registers (deliberately omitted).

note: 0x1240 CellSta; bit n set = cell n+1 exists
0x1248 MaxVolCellNbr (first-listed byte = high byte). Cell numbering base (0 or 1) not stated by JK; verify
0x128C CellWireResSta; bit n set = balance line alarm on cell n+1
0x1294 BatWatt; mW. JK lists it unsigned: take the direction from the sign of current
0x12A0 alarm bitmask; names in the protocol JSON. Bits 22 and 23 are numbered by their order in the JK table
0x12BA UserAlarm; bit meanings are not published by JK
0x12C2 UserAlarm2; bit meanings are not published by JK

documented_name: Discharge Short Circuit Protection Release Time
Charge Short Circuit Protection Release Time

note: 0x12EE ChargerPlugged (low byte; the high byte is reserved)
0x106C CellCount; number of series cells set in the BMS
0x1108 DevAddr; Modbus slave address; also set by the DIP switches
0x1448 FirstOnDate; unofficial (not in the JK document)
0x1450 SerialNo; unofficial (not in the JK document)
